title: Resurfacing Authority Envelope
purpose: Separate noticing that retained context is relevant from authority to return that context to the learner's foreground.
rules: Relevance may justify noticing, but relevance alone never grants resurfacing authority.
Immediate resurfacing requires an active learner-authored authority in the same declared scope.
A Turtle or system proposal cannot silently upgrade itself into a learner watchpoint or request.
Resurfacing authority is not interruption authority; this envelope cannot authorize a proactive interruption.
A local resurfacing authority cannot become a generalized person-wide preference or cross-scope default.
Authority does not silently carry across sessions and machine scoring cannot decide that it should.
Human availability, receptivity, attention, and silence are not inferred as permission.
Quiet non-resurfacing remains a valid outcome even when retained context is relevant.
The learner may mute or revoke resurfacing authority without negotiating with Turtle.
The envelope references canonical retained context and does not copy raw private dialogue or authorize broader collection.
